placements.title: The authority to command what the record must not hold
placements.frame: What does it mean when an authority directs the systematic removal of specific knowledge — and asserts the erased action never occurred?
placements.why: All three segments perform a coordinated erasure act: two imperative commands to forget and remove knowledge about a named instrument, measurement, and person, followed by a flat declarative denying the institution ever performed the action being erased. Together they name a thematic subject — the authority to determine what the record retains and what it must discard — that future envelopes could feed. The graph is empty; nothing existing holds this theme.
